random.description: This is a photomicrograph of a renal biopsy showing a glomerulus stained with Congo red. The left image demonstrates amorphous pink-red deposits within the glomerular mesangium and capillary loops. The right image, viewed under polarized light, reveals the characteristic apple-green birefringence of these deposits. These findings are diagnostic of renal amyloidosis.
